dictionary_contract: Fixed before submission; compilation is dictionary-only and independent of test addresses.
primary_scope: Launch to receipt of complete console stdout result in a fresh process per address.

measurement_contract.timer: parent perf_counter_ns immediately before Popen until complete stdout JSONL result is received
includes: prepared file open/mapping and header checks
JSON encoding and stdout flush/pipe capture
excludes: harness input setup and fixture parsing
measurement_contract.cold_definition: fresh interpreter and matcher for every address; zero cold warmups; no result cache or persistent worker
measurement_contract.filesystem_cache: OS file/page caches are uncontrolled; harness preflight reads bundle files
measurement_contract.bytecode: checked-hash runtime bytecode is shipped in the prepared bundle; all source is also included
measurement_contract.source_only_command_note: source-only commands refer to a temporary copy removed after measurement
measurement_contract.protocol: UTF-8 JSON strings on stdin, three-field JSON objects captured from stdout; no prediction file
measurement_contract.process_exit: separately recorded; every child must also exit successfully within the timeout

batch_process.note: Separate throughput diagnostic; never substituted for cold latency

limitations: The official dictionary, interpreter environment, accepted launch flags and bytecode packaging contract are not yet available.
Passing primary reports require explicit -S and the shipped checked-hash bytecode. Default startup and source-only means fail.
If timing includes process exit, both no-site means exceed 10 ms; inclusive exit distributions are retained separately.
OS page caches are uncontrolled; harness preflight verifies and reads bundle files before measurement.
Observed maxima are not universal bounds for all inputs or machines; scale mean has little headroom.
Original user expectations retain six documented ambiguous accentless wards; compilation preserves the existing null policy.
Complete raw records and predictions are in ignored full reports at the recorded paths and hashes; this checked-in artifact summarizes them.
